notes.title: Game Saving is Here!
notes.notes:
[h2]Game saving added to Settletopia[/h2][p][/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Game Saving is Here[/b] 
You can now save and load your game progress at any time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiplayer-Compatible Saves[/b] 
Saved games work in both single-player and multiplayer modes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Game doesn't ask to input player name every time. Instead it is retrieved from Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where items would disappear when leaving and returning to a location.[/p][/*][*][p]Many internal improvements and cleanups that pave the way for smoother future updates and features.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Save Compatibility Notes[/h3][list][*][p]During development, older saves may become incompatible with newer versions. I’ll do my best to preserve compatibility — but [b]no promises until we hit official release[/b].[/p][/*][/list]
